title: A Five Sentence Term Paper Using Chi2 Analysis
text:
Introduction
Research Question: Does the color of the book predict the genre of the book?
Colors give books presence and flavor, allowing prospective readers to judge a book by its metaphorical cover, but do the colors of a book accurately predict what its genre will be?


Literature
Previous researchers have tumultuously discussed the incredibly divisive topic of what colors school folders should be, and have painstakingly laid the necessary groundwork to gather foothold on how to precisely create an experiment to understand book color and book genre (Vayadande et al. 2024).


Method

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

import seaborn as sns
from scipy.stats import chi2_contingency

domain = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com"
path = "/adamrossnelson/confident/refs/heads/main/data/"
file = "confident_fictional_books.csv"

books = pd.read_csv(domain + path + file)

Our null hypothesis is that book cover color does not predict the book’s genre while the alternate hypothesis is that book cover color does predict the book’s genre and we study this question with data from 359 books where we know the book’s genre and the book’s cover color such that we can conduct a chi2 test to see if these two varaibles are either independent or dependent (as it turns out our chi2 test will involve a 6 x 6 test). # Results

# Conduct the chi2 with chi2_contingency by passing the observed
x2, pval, degf, _ = chi2_contingency(
    pd.crosstab(
        books['book_genre'],
        books['book_color']))

Results: Chi2 Stat: 1.99210 - Pvalue: 1.00000 - Degrees of Freedon: 25.
With a Chi2 statistic result of 1.99210 and a p-value nearly equal to 1.00000 (degrees of freedom 25) we fail to reject our null hypothesis and conclude that given these data, and given this analytical approach, there is no evidence to believe that a book’s cover color may predict that book’s genre.


Discussion
Regretably, there is no significant relationship between book color and book genre, thus closing the book on this research question, ending with us retaining the NULL hypothesis.


References


Vayadande, Kuldeep, Preeti Bailke, Ashutosh M Kulkarni, R Kumar, and Ajit B Patil. 2024. “Book Genre Prediction Using NLP: A Review.” How Machine Learning Is Innovating Today’s World: A Concise Technical Guide, 37–46.
